import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

The orange JSON on `eat` is a presentation failure of a sound data model. Keep the nested `record:` mapping, hide that Properties row on album notes, and edit the contract on a Schema Card that writes through `bob albums update`.

The independent report is `research:202611/album_record_schema_obsidian_ux__grk.md`. Artifact: `file:explicit:9c7298596f7adb82e7637ba0`.

**Why Properties is the wrong editor.** Obsidian still does not support nested properties, so `record` renders as a truncated unsupported-type blob. Clicking it can save a string instead of a mapping; bob then rejects the album (`record must be a mapping`). The parser already has a `recover_album_noun` helper for that exact failure.

**What to keep from the albums plan.** A4 (one nested `record:` mapping), generated `[!records]` indexes, and “plugin paints, bob writes” stay. `bob-cli-k3.7.1.4` is already supposed to hide the row and draw a schema card; that phase has not shipped, which is why the screenshot still shows the blob.

**What to change.** The original “edit in Source mode / paste YAML after `bob albums create`” path is too timid. Promote the planned **read-only** card to an **editable Schema Card** whose chips match the index (`🔖 To try` on the card is the same token as `🔖 11 to try` in the list). Safe edits (add a choice, add a field, toggle dated notes) are one click. Renames, deletes, and new required fields confirm with an impact count.

**Do not** flatten keys, adopt Nested Properties / Metadata Menu FileClass, or put the schema in a body callout.

Ship in two slices: hide + glance card first (unblocks the screenshot), then `bob albums update` + the editor. Grow `bob albums list -f json` additively with `dated_notes`, `legacy`, and `suggest` so the card can round-trip the full contract without parsing YAML.
